name: Itapoá (Brazil)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Itapoá is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 11 September 1990 (created by Municipal Law No. 55 of 11 September 1990, amended by Law No. 835 of 2019, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a landscape and wheat, reading ITAPOÁ - SC 26-4 1989
